crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Ledger Anomaly Detection
children.blurb: Ledger anomaly detection in continuous audit and assurance uses automated checks to find unusual entries, patterns, or balances in general ledgers and subledgers that may indicate error, fraud, or control failure.

children.name: Substantive Testing at Full Coverage
children.blurb: Substantive testing at full coverage means applying audit procedures to every transaction or record in a population rather than a sample.

children.name: Inventory Observation and Valuation
children.blurb: This page covers the use of artificial intelligence in the continuous audit and assurance of inventory observation and valuation.

children.name: Going Concern Analysis
children.blurb: Going concern analysis in continuous audit and assurance assesses whether a company can meet its obligations for at least twelve months from the reporting date.

children.name: Internal Control Testing
children.blurb: Internal control testing is the process of evaluating whether controls over financial reporting, operations, and compliance are designed appropriately and operating effectively.

sections.body: Continuous audit and assurance uses AI to check financial records and controls on an ongoing basis rather than once a year. In ledger anomaly detection, machine learning models scan journal entries for unusual amounts, timing, or user access patterns. Substantive testing at full coverage means AI can examine every transaction in a population instead of a small sample, comparing invoices, payments, and contracts against each other. Inventory observation uses image recognition and sensor data to count stock or estimate valuation from photos and warehouse feeds. Going concern analysis applies language models to management statements, market data, and cash flow forecasts to flag signs a company may not survive the next year. Internal control testing uses process mining and log analysis to see whether approval rules and segregation of duties are actually followed.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: The work is real but uneven. Ledger anomaly detection is the most mature, with many audit firms and enterprise software vendors offering tools that reduce false positives but still require human review. Full coverage substantive testing is possible for structured data like sales and payroll, but messy documents, handwritten notes, and intercompany agreements still resist reliable automation. Inventory observation works well in controlled warehouses with fixed cameras or RFID tags, but fails in outdoor sites, piles of bulk material, or when items look alike. Going concern analysis remains largely assistive, because the models cannot reliably weigh qualitative factors like management credibility or pending litigation. Internal control testing can detect missing approvals in digital systems, but many controls are manual, informal, or undocumented, so the AI sees only part of the picture.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: A reader looking for how AI spots suspicious entries should start with Ledger Anomaly Detection, which explains the core detection methods. Substantive Testing at Full Coverage then shows what happens when those methods are applied to every record rather than a sample, and where the data must be structured. Inventory Observation and Valuation moves from documents to physical assets, covering what cameras and sensors can and cannot verify. Going Concern Analysis shifts the focus from past transactions to future survival, using text and forecast data. Internal Control Testing closes the loop by examining the processes meant to prevent errors in the first place, so the five pages together follow the flow from detecting a problem to testing the system around it.
